name: 80549 · Wellington, CO
findings: ZIP 80549 (Wellington) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80549 (Wellington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80549 (Wellington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
